tools.name: search_guruhotel_knowledge
tools.description: Search GuruHotel's published knowledge base: product pages, integration pages, and guides about direct bookings, hotel websites, booking engines, payments and AI/agentic booking. Returns matching pages with a snippet and a markdown mirror URL that can be fetched for the full content.

tools.name: get_product_facts
tools.description: Published, verified facts about GuruHotel the company and product: positioning, capabilities, traction metrics, payments (Stripe) and markets. Same data as https://guruhotel.com/data/guruhotel-product.json.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: GuruHotel's published pricing model (commission-based with optional subscription plans). There is no public rate card; includes the pricing page URL and sales contact.

tools.name: get_integrations
tools.description: Full inventory of GuruHotel's PMS/connectivity integrations with their status: 'live' (direct), 'via-channex' (evidenced Channex connection), 'compatible' (works through Channex, confirmed during onboarding), 'beta' or 'unverified'. Same data as https://guruhotel.com/data/guruhotel-integrations.json

tools.name: check_pms_compatibility
tools.description: Check whether a specific hotel PMS (property management system) works with GuruHotel, e.g. 'Cloudbeds', 'Mews', 'Oracle OPERA'. Answers with the connection type (direct or via Channex) and next steps when unconfirmed.

tools.name: get_page_markdown
tools.description: Fetch the full markdown version of any GuruHotel page by its URL path (e.g. 'blog/how-ai-agents-book-hotels' or 'integrations/pms/cloudbeds'). Use search_guruhotel_knowledge first to discover pages.
